entities.name: Volrath's Laboratory
entities.description: Room in the Stronghold where the Evincar of Rath placed many experiments, shifted to Urborg during the Rathi Overlay.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: Evincar of Rath whose experiments aimed at transcendence of the flesh.

entities.name: Stronghold
entities.description: Structure containing the laboratory, later shifted to Urborg.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: Place on Dominaria to which the Stronghold shifted.

entities.name: Volrath's Dungeon
entities.description: Housed in the same building as the lab.

entities.name: Moggs
entities.description: Creatures adapted from goblins in the lab.

entities.name: Weatherlight Crew
entities.description: Crew who entered the laboratory searching for Sisay and Takara.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: Captain whose shapeshifter double appeared in a vat.

entities.name: Rathi Overlay
entities.description: Event that shifted the Stronghold to Urborg.

events.summary: During the assault on Rath, part of the Weatherlight crew enters the laboratory searching for Sisay and Takara and finds experiments, including Sisay in a vat.
events.quote: They found several of his twisted experiments and saw Sisay in one of the vats

events.summary: The Sisay in the vat turns out to be a shapeshifter and attacks; it is killed.
events.quote: she turned out to be a shapeshifter and attacked them

events.summary: Gerrard and Mirri smash the glass tubs, vats and tubes before moving on.
events.quote: Gerrard and Mirri smashed all the glass tubs, vats and tubes they could find

events.summary: During the Rathi Overlay the laboratory shifts with the Stronghold to Urborg.
events.quote: the laboratory was shifted with the rest of the Stronghold to Urborg on Dominaria

relations.note: adapted from goblins in the lab
relations.quote: The moggs were first adapted from normal goblins within this chamber
